requirement: Retrieves from the Build-1 Lakebase Search index (native hybrid vector+BM25 over app.products) — NOT a separate vector store.

search_indexes_on_app_products.indexdef: CREATE INDEX products_ann ON app.products USING lakebase_ann (embedding vector_cosine_ops)
CREATE INDEX products_bm25 ON app.products USING lakebase_bm25 (search_tsv)

app_code: server/main.py :: rm_recommendations() — embeds the customer query with databricks-gte-large-en, then runs a Reciprocal-Rank-Fusion query JOINing lakebase_ann (vector) + lakebase_bm25 (full-text) indexes on app.products. Retrieval never leaves Lakebase; there is no external/separate vector store.
query_text: affluent tier customer, 13 year tenure. affluent tier relationship, 13 year tenure, home metro Dallas . Holds a maturing certificate of deposit; rate-sensitive, comparing competitor savings rates. Currently holds High-Yield Savings. Recommend complementary wealth, investment, lending or deposit products to deepen the relationship.

ranked_results.description: Managed wealth advisory account with a dedicated advisor. For affluent and private-tier customers with investable assets; a cross-sell for high-balance depositors.
30-year fixed-rate home mortgage. For homebuyers; a long-tenure relationship product.
18-month term CD for savers locking in a fixed rate; penalty on early withdrawal. For rate-focused deposit customers.
Revolving home-equity line of credit. For homeowners with equity; a lending cross-sell for established relationship customers.
Premium rewards credit card, travel + cashback perks. For mass-affluent and above with strong relationship tenure; a cross-sell for depositors without a card.
